title: Archery Land
description:
Welcome to Archery Land.　　Allowed by goddess, a legend warrior
　　whose mission is to protect the shrine of water in Archery Land.
　　The monster is hurting people to get water.
　　Clear the 6 ordeals and kill the monster, trying to invade the shrine!
　　

　　
　　　ㆍSpawn bow & arrow with left and right hand according to the voice of the goddess.
　　 Clear the 6 ordeals! and kill the monster!
　
　　Hit all the targets in time!
　　

　
　　Hit the target that is moving away!
　　

　
　　Hit all the targets!
　　

　
　　Hit the jumping target!
　　

　
　　Hit the flying target!
　　

　
　　Hit the targets in sequence!
　　

　
　　Shot & Killing monster!!
　　

　　
　　　ㆍSPEED, TRAP, FLIGHT: Watch out! Time limit.
　　　ㆍLONG, ACCURACY, MEMORY: Score Clear!
　　　ㆍBOSS : Kill the monster before you die. Become the warrior of the warriors.
　
　　1v1 turn-based shooting game!
　　Hit all the opponent's targets and try to knock them off the void.
description_short: Archery Land is a single, multiplayer VR shooting game, and Enjoy the thrilling feeling of hitting the target in our Archery Land by aiming the bow at the wide land.
